coords: root_motion in Godot character space: +x = character left, +z = character forward (metres)

sprint.notes: built from run 102_05: time x0.86, stride x1.12, lean+arm pump

dribble.notes: jog 35_18 + hand-keyed right-foot touch and head-down layer

kick_long.notes: instep kick with extra lean-back around contact (lofted ball)

kick_pass.notes: instep kick source turned into a side-foot pass (leg external rotation layer)

volley.notes: instep kick with contact raised ~0.35 m and torso leaning back (no volley mocap exists)

gk_dive_low_r.notes: hand-keyed low collapse dive to the right

gk_dive_r.notes: hand-keyed lateral dive to the right, lands on right side

fall.notes: hand-keyed tripped fall from a run, ends face down (matches getup start)

slide.notes: hand-keyed slide tackle incl. getting up

trap_chest.notes: hand-keyed: chest out, arms wide, lean back, cushion, lean forward to drop the ball

throw_in.notes: hand-keyed two-handed throw-in from behind the head, feet planted

dejected.notes: hand-keyed: hands on head, looks up then drops the head (ends in hold pose)

tackle.notes: hand-keyed standing poke tackle (lunging stab of the right leg)

stepover_r.notes: hand-keyed step-over with the right foot (feint right)

drag_back.notes: hand-keyed drag-back: right sole pulls the ball back

emote_point_sky.notes: both arms point to the sky, head up

emote_arms_crossed.notes: arms crossed on the chest, chin up

gk_kick.notes: punt: kick_long source, ball held in both hands until ~0.3 s before contact, contact raised 0.22 m

header.notes: standing two-foot jump (CMU 143, 60 Hz) + hand-keyed head nod

getup.notes: from lying face down to standing

celebrate_2.notes: jubilating jump, arms up, drops to the knees (ends kneeling)

celebrate_3.notes: fist pumps up, then crouched pumping/stamping

celebrate_1.notes: celebration run: jog 35_17 with both arms raised (hand-keyed arm layer)

kick_run.notes: Mixamo "Strike Forward Jog": instep strike out of a jog (shots/long balls at speed)

slide_mx.notes: Mixamo "Soccer Slide Tackle": slide on the hip, right leg into the ball, gets up

fall_mx.notes: Mixamo "Soccer Trip": tripped by a tackle, tumbles and lands on the ground

getup_mx.notes: Mixamo "Standing Up From A Soccer Fall"

gk_dive_mx_l.notes: Mixamo goalkeeper diving save (includes getting up)

gk_dive_mx_r.notes: Mixamo goalkeeper diving save (includes getting up)
